author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
At master swordsmith Tony Swatton's workshop, Adam gets to examine and wield the hero Jack Sparrow pirate sword Tony made for the original Pirates of the Caribbean films! Adam learns how these swords were made, as well as their scabbards. Tony also brings out an actual historical pirate sword to show how those feel and compare with the film props!

Find Tony Swatton's builds at https://thetonyswatton.com/ and subscribe to his new channel at https://www.youtube.com/@TheTonySwatton 

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
